text_block_list.text:
The scorching season is here! Summer 
training camp has begun once again this 
year.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When you think of summer, you think of the 
sun! And when you think of the sun, you 
think of the Supreme Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, summer is my season! This 
summer, I want to meet the 'BRAND NEW 
Overlord'!

I have no idea what she's talking about 
right off the bat, but... TM Opera O 
clearly possesses something profound deep 
within.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"BRAND NEW Overlord"! Which is to say, a 
completely new me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Envious gazes gather upon my overpowering 
strength. Along with relentless marking...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You will be able to overcome all of them 
and seize overwhelming victory!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That is what makes a 'BRAND NEW Supreme 
Overlord'! Even an Overlord must continue 
to evolve, after all."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufu... Don't you think this sea... is 
the perfect place to grow stronger, 
Trainer-kun?

Swimming in rough waves and beach running. 
It's an ideal environment for 
strengthening the core.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Mother Nature is what grants me 
new strength. For example—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Like Poseidon himself appearing to bestow 
his power upon me. Ahahaha!"

"...It seems the idea of getting stronger 
on her own hasn't even crossed her mind."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, regardless of how it happens, I will 
show you a reborn me this summer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Something is bound to happen. If it 
won't, then I'll make it happen!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So that I can become a king who can still 
claim victory with absolute composure, 
even when targeted!
